keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords to analyze, one per line (100+ supported). Duplicates are removed.

timeframe.title: Timeframe
timeframe.description: now 1-H, now 4-H, now 1-d, now 7-d, today 1-m, today 3-m, today 12-m, today 5-y, all (2004–today) or a custom range such as 2024-01-01 2024-12-31. Short forms work too: 7d, 90d, 12m, 5y.

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country code (US, IN, GB), region code (US-CA, GB-ENG) or country name (united_states). Empty = worldwide.

category.title: Category
category.description: Google Trends category ID or name. 0 / empty = all. Examples: 16 News, 71 Food & Drink, 20 Sports, 5 Computers & Electronics, 7 Finance, 174 Science, 18 Shopping, 67 Travel, 45 Health.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: Which Google search to measure: web search, YouTube, News, Images or Shopping.

compareMode.title: Keyword mode
compareMode.description: Separately: each keyword on its own 0–100 scale, with its own regions, related queries and topics. Together: all keywords on one shared 0–100 scale (share of search) — any number of keywords, batched 5 at a time with an anchor keyword so batches stay comparable.

includeInterestOverTime.title: Interest over time
includeInterestOverTime.description: Timeline of search interest (dates + values) and a summary (average, peak, peak date, latest, change %, trend direction).

includeInterestByRegion.title: Interest by region
includeInterestByRegion.description: Where the keyword is searched most.

regionResolution.title: Region level
regionResolution.description: Auto: countries for worldwide, states/provinces for a country. Metro areas (DMA) are available for the US.

maxRegions.title: Maximum regions
maxRegions.description: Keep only the top N regions per keyword. 0 = all.

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also list regions where Google has too little data (value 0).

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Top and rising related searches (rising values are % growth; "Breakout" = more than +5000%).

includeRelatedTopics.title: Related topics
includeRelatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics. Google hides topics from IPs it sees as automated; the scraper then retries through a residential IP (when available) and reports the status in related_topics_status.

retryTopicsWithResidential.title: Retry hidden topics with a residential IP
retryTopicsWithResidential.description: When Google hides related topics, fetch them once more through an Apify RESIDENTIAL IP (tiny traffic, no extra charge).

includeTrending.title: Include trending searches
includeTrending.description: Also fetch today's trending searches (with approximate search volume, start time, picture and news articles).

trendingCountry.title: Trending countries
trendingCountry.description: Country names or codes, comma-separated: united_states, india, united_kingdom, DE, JP…

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of region and topic names (hl), e.g. en-US, de, fr, ja.

timezoneOffsetMinutes.title: Timezone offset (minutes)
timezoneOffsetMinutes.description: Timezone for hourly/daily data, as Google expects it: minutes WEST of UTC. 0 = UTC, 300 = New York (EST), -330 = India.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many charged results. 0 = no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed for most runs. If Google rate-limits the server IP, the scraper switches to Apify datacenter, then RESIDENTIAL proxies automatically.

proxyFallback.title: Automatic proxy fallback
proxyFallback.description: Switch to Apify proxies when Google keeps rate-limiting the current route.
